messages.subject: DT default stripe
parts:
The following code worked fine in earlier versions of DT.  Over the last month or so I am unable to turn off the default stripe in the table.  I would like to have stripes in two rows followed by no stripes in the next two rows, and so on.
 
 
require(DT)
options(stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 
N <- 10
df <- data.frame(var=paste0("var",rep(seq(1,N),each=2)), type=rep(c("pri","con"),N), value=runif(2*N))
df[df$type=="con",]$var <- ""
 
 
colnam <- c("Variable","Type","Value")
DT::datatable(df, options=list(autoWidth=TRUE, lengthChange=FALSE, paging=FALSE, searching=FALSE, ordering=FALSE, info=FALSE, language.thousands=",",
    columnDefs=list(list(className='dt-center', targets=seq(0,2)), list(width='30%', targets=0)),
    rowCallback=JS("function(row,data) {", "if($(row)['0']['_DT_RowIndex'] % 4 < 2)  $(row).css('background','#ededed')", "}")),
    container=htmltools::tags$table(class="row-border", htmltools::tags$thead(htmltools::tags$tr(lapply(colnam, htmltools::tags$th)))),
    rownames=FALSE, selection="none") %>% formatRound('value', 3)

parts:
You can move class = 'row-border' from htmltools::table() to datatable(), e.g.

library(DT)

options(stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

N <- 10
df <- data.frame(var=paste0("var",rep(seq(1,N),each=2)),
type=rep(c("pri","con"),N), value=runif(2*N))
df[df$type=="con",]$var <- ""


colnam <- c("Variable","Type","Value")
DT::datatable(df, options=list(autoWidth=TRUE, lengthChange=FALSE,
paging=FALSE, searching=FALSE, ordering=FALSE, info=FALSE,
language.thousands=",",

columnDefs=list(list(className='dt-center', targets=seq(0,2)),
list(width='30%', targets=0)),
rowCallback=JS("function(row,data) {",
"if($(row)['0']['_DT_RowIndex'] % 4 < 2)
$(row).css('background','#ededed')", "}")),
